metadata.description: Plugins for working with ymer.ax — one plugin per practice, its moves the skills it ships or the process rows it points at. Using any plugin requires a ymer.ax account and one folder for state, under version control; install `setup`, name the folder, and run `/setup:env` to check both and create the floors that are missing.

plugins.name: setup
plugins.description: One-time setup for the ymer marketplace — verifies the state folder and the ymer connection, creates the Meta Roadmap project, and checks all three again whenever you ask.

plugins.name: kaizen
plugins.description: Continuous improvement over your working process — capture frictions as you work, drain them into improvement work. The practice lives as two processes in your Ymer Node's notebook, not as skills.
